_comment: Logical quarantine: exclusions keyed by carrier ID + relative member path + payload SHA-256, per OP-PROT-019 §6. Frozen bytes and old manifests stay intact; what is excluded is the certification claim that rests on them, at the named scope. Restoration needs a new erratum/successor and a fresh review. Transcribed from registers/json/quarantine_index.json (GP-REG-032-v1.2, xlsx export 2026-09-18): 17 rows from the R17 pass of 2026-09-17T16:25:48Z and the five RN5 rows Q-RN5-MOMENT-001..004 and Q-RN5-LM004-A1 of 2026-09-17T17:19:16Z, all class DEFECTIVE_SCOPE. Payload hashes resolved from drive/source_map/Archive_Members.csv (archive members) and drive/inventory.jsonl (Drive objects). A DEFECTIVE_SCOPE exclusion excludes the affected claim and preserves valid unrelated content (OP-PROT-019 §6); it is not a declaration that every mathematical conclusion in the object is false. A member this repository binds byte-exact stays bound and carries the exclusion key and scope on its binding record (engine/rn_engine/BINDING.json, engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json), which tools/quarantine_check.py requires.
